note: Each `text` is one receipt exactly as the launcher fsyncs it and embeds it in stopped/uncertain. Positive entries must parse and re-serialize byte for byte. Text version 2: every receipt has `"v":2`, and a Class A receipt ends with `mac` (see `macVectors`).

macVectors.note: HMAC-SHA256 over the receipt's canonical text WITHOUT the `mac` key (`macInput`: UTF-8, schema key order, no whitespace, no trailing newline), under a 32 byte key; the MAC is the 32 raw bytes in canonical padded base64 (44 characters) as the last key of the receipt. The key is SYNTHETIC. `expect` is `mac-valid` (parses, MAC verifies under `keyBase64`), `mac-invalid` (parses, MAC does not verify) or `parse:<code>` (refused by the strict parser).

negative.name: wrong-mac-right-shape
negative.why: a well-formed MAC that is not this receipt's

negative.name: mac-of-another-receipt
negative.why: a valid MAC copied from a different receipt

negative.name: signed-with-another-key
negative.why: signed under a different synthetic key

negative.name: content-changed-after-signing
negative.why: a binding field edited after the MAC was made

negative.name: mac-not-last
negative.why: mac moved out of last position
